card.title: SB2C HELLDIVER
card.text: When you gain an extra kredit slot, add a copy of this unit to your hand.
card.flavorText: The Curtiss SB2C Helldiver was an American carrier based dive bomber that was in the service of the United States Navy in the Pacific theater during WWII. The Helldiver was meant to replace the Douglas SBD Dauntless, but it did not make a good first impression. The Helldiver was faster than the Dauntless and it also had folding wings that saved storage space on the carriers, but it had major faults such as being underpowered, with shorter range than the Dauntless and frequent maintenance problems. When the first SB2C Helldivers started to enter service in 1943 their poor performance led to many accidents, they either ran out of fuel or crashed during landing. Both its pilots and aircraft carrier crew took an instant dislike to the aircraft, so much that it earned the nickname “The Beast” and “Son of a bitch 2nd class”. However, in 1944 the SB2C-3 variant was finally introduced, it had an upgraded engine and a Curtiss four bladed propeller which solved its lack of power and ultimately the aircraft started to score some incredible success in the Pacific theater. The Helldiver made an important contribution in several battles over the Philippines, Iwo Jima, Okinawa and would play an important role in sinking the Japanese heavy battleships Yamato and Musashi, plus several regular sized battleships, aircraft carriers and other ships.
